title: Glen Mapes, et al. v. Metropolitan New York Presbytery
disposition_detail: Dismissed as moot and not judicially in order; no merits determination. The requested congregational meeting/vote was never ordered, and the later presbytery action dismissing the congregation, followed by congregational consent, removed the basis for the requested remedy.
first_summary: Glen Mapes and others complained after a temporary session denied their request for a congregational meeting to vote on leaving the PCA. The SJC dismissed the complaint as moot and not judicially in order: the presbytery had since dismissed the congregation in October 2018, and the congregation consented in December 2018. Three commissioners dissented; one was disqualified.
summary: A complaint sought a congregational meeting to vote on leaving the PCA after the temporary session denied the request in November 2017. The SJC dismissed the complaint as moot and not judicially in order. Both parties agreed at the panel hearing that the presbytery had voted in October 2018 to dismiss the congregation pending consent under BCO 13-9(f), and consent was given at a December 2018 called meeting. No merits ruling was made. Three commissioners dissented; one was disqualified.
